verdict.rationale: First-party product copy states almost verbatim that Claude Code maps and explains entire codebases, using agentic search to understand project structure and dependencies without manual context-file selection (docs-15). The overview and GitHub README back this up with claims that it understands your entire codebase and explains complex code (docs-51, gh-3). missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how agentic search and codebase mapping work, independent or hands-on corroboration of whole-codebase explanation quality on unfamiliar repos.
